`tools/fetch_runtime.sh` puts the CIX NOE runtime here (not committed, CIX/Arm China licence):

* `libnoe-3.1.2-py3-none-manylinux2014_aarch64.whl` from `cix-noe-umd_3.1.2_arm64.deb`
* `libaipudrv.so` (= `libaipu_driver.so` from `cix-npu-onnxruntime_1.2.0_arm64.deb`)

Both come from Radxa's public release [radxa-pkg/cix-prebuilt 26Q2-2607](https://github.com/radxa-pkg/cix-prebuilt/releases/tag/26Q2-2607).
